content.title: About
content.content: Oat milk is a plant‑based beverage made from whole oat grains, water, and sometimes added ingredients (sweeteners, flavorings, vitamins). It has a mild creamy taste, a slightly sweet oat aroma, and a light‑cream color. Oat milk is suitable for vegans, people with lactose intolerance, and anyone looking for a dairy‑free alternative.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Oat milk gained popularity in Scandinavia in the early 1990s.
Oats contain beta‑glucans, which may help lower cholesterol levels.
Unlike many nut milks, oat milk typically contains no nuts, making it safe for most allergy sufferers.
Producing oat milk uses less water than producing cow’s milk.
Oat milk creates a stable foam, which is why it’s favored for coffee drinks.

items.title: Rich in beta‑glucans
items.content: Beta‑glucans support healthy cholesterol levels and contribute to immune function.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Oat milk provides thiamine, riboflavin, and niacin, which are important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains iron and magnesium
items.content: These minerals are essential for blood formation and normal muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Oat milk fits well into diets that limit saturated fat intake.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The fiber from oats can help maintain regular bowel movements.

items.title: Oat allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to oats.

items.title: Gluten content
items.content: Oats are often processed on shared equipment with wheat, so trace gluten may be present.

items.title: Added sugars
items.content: Some brands sweeten their oat milk, increasing calorie content.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Oat milk can raise blood sugar levels more quickly than some other plant milks.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Oat milk can be enjoyed on its own, added to coffee, tea, smoothies, cereals, baked goods, sauces, and soups. It is also used as a base for vegan desserts and ice cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store opened oat milk in the refrigerator for up to 5–7 days. Keep unopened cartons in a cool, dry place away from direct light.
